description: Restaurants '26: Value Sit Down backdrop — FRED sales/CPI/beef PPI/sentiment + BLS wages + USDA Choice cutout + Indeed Hiring Lab food-service postings + OpenTable US seated YoY. Forums in value_sit_down_forums.

series.label: Retail Sales: Food Services and Drinking Places
series.official_name: FRED MRTSSM722USN — Retail Sales: Food Services and Drinking Places
